title: Part-time Mentor and Web Developer
summary: Mentored 18 high-school students in Java and robotics software for the FIRST Robotics Competition.
highlights: Guided robot design and build work, resulting in a functional robot that qualified for regional events.
Developed a responsive team website promoting four major sponsors.

title: Volunteer Python and Machine Learning Instructor
summary: Coached three semesters of Women in Tech cohorts from underrepresented communities.
highlights: Taught Python, Flask, and Peewee and guided capstone projects.
Developed a programming, machine learning, and data analysis curriculum with six mentors.
The curriculum empowered over 20 students to land jobs.
